# Lucide 1.70.0 (ISC)

Icons from the npm package `lucide-static@1.70.0` (https://lucide.dev), `icons/<name>.svg`, as they are.

**Design-system spike only**: just the icons `#/lab` shows. The app's own icons are still the paths copied into
`static/js/ui.js` `ICONS`; replacing them with the full set and a generated map is a later phase
(plans/design-system.md).

To update: `npm pack lucide-static@<version>` in an empty folder outside the repo and copy the icons needed and `LICENSE`.
